title: Evidence-grounded API load-test decisions across prompt and tool systems
question: For the four pinned models and controlled workloads, does EAL/2 with MCP increase correct measured-run decisions over JSON prompts and ordinary developer prompts?

scope.system_or_population: One controlled orders API, four workload profiles, five prompt/tool arms and four pinned OpenAI model snapshots; no production or model-class-wide inference.
scope.conditions: Docker on one runner; fixed token, call and cost limits; live Responses API calls; fresh loopback HTTP measurements.
scope.spatial_scope: One container and its loopback network.
scope.temporal_scope: Each invocation and its recorded model snapshots; no timeless generalisation.

claims.statement: The combined EAL/MCP system improves measured-run decision accuracy by more than five percentage points for a specified model and comparator under this protocol.
claims.scope_limit: One controlled orders API, four workload profiles, five prompt/tool arms and four pinned OpenAI model snapshots; no production or model-class-wide inference.
claims.success_consequence: Report only the individually supported model/comparator contrast.
claims.failure_consequence: Report inconclusive or disadvantage; do not claim a general EAL benefit.

assumptions.statement: Separate paired blocks are independent enough for the stated uncertainty bounds, with stable model behaviour during an invocation.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Fresh sessions, randomised arm order, recorded timestamps and snapshot identities; temporal drift remains a limitation.

assumptions.statement: The independent reference and collector correctly implement the finite measurement criteria.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Real HTTP/MCP controls plus inclusive-boundary, identity, freshness and fabrication tests.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Suspend affected outcome interpretation; fix and version materials before a new invocation.

hypotheses.label: Executable assessment advantage
hypotheses.statement: Checked scope, evidence and criteria reduce erroneous decisions enough to exceed five percentage points for at least one prespecified contrast.
hypotheses.scope: One controlled orders API, four workload profiles, five prompt/tool arms and four pinned OpenAI model snapshots; no production or model-class-wide inference.

hypotheses.label: Easy-task ceiling or added complexity
hypotheses.statement: Direct measurements already suffice, or EAL complexity offsets its checks, so no prespecified contrast exceeds five percentage points.
hypotheses.scope: One controlled orders API, four workload profiles, five prompt/tool arms and four pinned OpenAI model snapshots; no production or model-class-wide inference.

hypotheses.label: Per-contrast null
hypotheses.statement: EAL accuracy minus comparator accuracy is at most 0.05.
hypotheses.scope: One controlled orders API, four workload profiles, five prompt/tool arms and four pinned OpenAI model snapshots; no production or model-class-wide inference.

predictions.expected_pattern: At least one prespecified model/comparator difference has a multiplicity-adjusted lower bound above 0.05.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Difference greater than 0.05 on the binary accuracy scale.
predictions.tolerance: Metrics within 0.01 units and exact count; uncertainty from bounded paired differences.

constructs.name: Evidence-grounded measured-run accuracy
constructs.definition: The model collects its assigned run and reports the independently correct status and numeric measurements.
constructs.scope: One controlled orders API, four workload profiles, five prompt/tool arms and four pinned OpenAI model snapshots; no production or model-class-wide inference.
validity_evidence: Positive and negative real HTTP controls
validity_threats: A simple task may produce ceiling accuracy
Narrative explanation quality is retained but not automatically graded

measurements.observable: Binary correctness; false support; raw request durations/statuses/identities; model calls, tokens, known cost and latency.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: perf_counter_ns HTTP client; collector.py; independent oracle.py; native Responses API usage.
measurements.scale_or_units: Binary correctness; milliseconds; error percentage; count; USD estimates.
measurements.timing: One collection per assigned trial; assessment immediately after collection; final answer within four model calls.
measurements.preprocessing: Nearest-rank p95 over every attempt; non-2xx and transport failures count as errors; no retries or outlier removal.
measurements.calibration: Tests at inclusive 200 ms, 1 percent and 100-request boundaries; eight real HTTP route controls before paid calls.
measurements.reliability: Request timings vary by host; reference uses the actual report for that trial, not the intended profile label.
measurements.validity: Finite criteria for the identified measured run only; structured/1 preserves authored rationale and checks declared dependencies.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Identical collector, thresholds and grader across arms/models; EAL additionally receives host assessment.
measurements.reactivity: The load test consumes runner CPU and sockets; sequential trials and shuffled arm order limit order bias.
measurements.error_model: Timing variability is measured; failed collections and malformed or absent answers score zero, separately labelled.
measurements.blinding: Deterministic grader sees raw records and answer, not model class or arm; investigators are unblinded.

design.rationale: Paired workload blocks compare the combined systems under equal measurement access.
design.setting: Controlled local HTTP service in Docker, with live remote model inference.
design.temporal_structure: Fresh sequential trials grouped by model, repeat and profile.
design.assignment_method: Freeze seeded shuffled profile blocks and arm order before first paid call.
design.allocation_concealment: Models receive only their current prompt and tool results, without profile names or other arms.
design.comparator: Meaning-equivalent JSON prompt plus three ordinary developer prompts, each with direct collector and no MCP/checker.

units.target_population_or_system: One controlled orders API, four workload profiles, five prompt/tool arms and four pinned OpenAI model snapshots; no production or model-class-wide inference.
units.sampling_frame: Four selected model snapshots crossed with four selected profiles.
units.experimental_unit: One fresh model session and actual HTTP run.
units.observational_unit: One final model decision; HTTP requests are nested measurements, not independent model trials.
units.analysis_unit: Paired accuracy difference within block; report models separately.
units.recruitment_or_selection: Purposive snapshot and profile selection, not random population sampling.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Five frozen prompt/tool arms in materials.py.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Acquisition and correct interpretation of run-specific evidence.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Native tool bridge to actual stdio MCP for EAL; direct subprocess collector for JSON/plain text.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: Maximum four calls, 4096 output tokens per call, one load test; frozen model-specific reasoning settings.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Randomised arm order within each block.
manipulation_checks: Retain prompt, tool catalogue and actual MCP trace
off_target_checks: Record tokens and latency because prompt size and checker access differ
recovery_checks: New service and model session for each assignment

controls.description: Healthy service, 100 requests, low delays and no intentional failures.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Nonfunctional HTTP collection or overly slow host.
controls.implementation: Both direct and MCP self-checks before paid runs.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Do not start paid workflow if healthy control fails.

controls.description: Slow service, 10-percent errors and 80-request short run.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Always-support checker or incomplete measurement acceptance.
controls.implementation: Three profiles on both routes plus reference tests for stale and wrong-identity reports.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Do not start paid workflow on control disagreement.

confounds.description: Notation, prompt length, checking authority and orchestration change together.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Observed effect cannot isolate syntax from host computation.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Define treatment as combined system; same collector and final answer schema.
confounds.diagnostic: Retain tool traces, token counts and prompts.

confounds.description: Runner or provider drift during sequential trials.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Time may alter latency, availability or model performance.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Seeded shuffled arms within paired blocks; actual report-specific scoring.
confounds.diagnostic: Timestamps, real raw durations and provider errors retained.
confounds.residual_risk: Correlated blocks invalidate inferential bounds; descriptive scope then applies.

estimands.population_or_system: One controlled orders API, four workload profiles, five prompt/tool arms and four pinned OpenAI model snapshots; no production or model-class-wide inference.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: EAL/2 plus MCP and executable dependency checks.
estimands.comparator: JSON prompt and plain_brief, separately for each model; other plain variants secondary.
estimands.time: The invocation and its fixed snapshots.
estimands.summary_measure: Mean within-block binary accuracy difference, equally weighted over four profiles.
estimands.interpretation: Combined-system performance difference under assigned conditions.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Arm determines prompt and assessment access; workload and model define blocks; raw requests determine independent reference; answer determines score.
identified_parameters: Assigned-run accuracy difference for these snapshots and profiles
rescue_actions: Restrict to descriptive results if assumptions fail
Version corrected protocol and rerun as new evidence

sampling.method: Fixed purposive factorial design with seeded within-block order.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: Smoke: one repeat, 80 trials; study: ten repeats, 800 trials and 40 paired blocks per model.
sampling.dependence_structure: Pair five arms within each model-repeat-profile block; requests and model calls are not replication units.
sampling.multiplicity: Bonferroni alpha 0.05/8 for primary contrasts even when a model subset is selected.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Retain all planned assignments; incomplete trials score zero and inference is disabled.
sampling.result: At n=40 the primary Hoeffding half-width is about 0.537. This economical study can establish only large differences; it is not powered to distinguish a five-point effect.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Report profile-stratified paired bootstrap as exploratory; it cannot trigger conclusions. About 4615 independent blocks would be needed for a 0.05 Hoeffding half-width at this alpha.
sampling.stopping_implications: Fixed sample; provider failure, unknown usage, identity mismatch or cost admission failure stops that model and labels remaining assignments unattempted.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Frozen materials.py and oracle.py hashed in manifest before paid calls.
analysis.exclusion_lock: No removal, favourable reruns or response repair after grading.

models.model_or_procedure: Paired differences with bounded-difference Hoeffding intervals; exploratory stratified paired bootstrap.

contrasts: Primary: EAL minus JSON and plain_brief for each of four models
Secondary: EAL minus plain_explicit and plain_review
analysis.uncertainty: Hoeffding radius sqrt(2 log(2/alpha)/n); clip to [-1,1]; at least 20 blocks and five per profile. Bootstrap uses 10000 seeded resamples.
analysis.multiplicity: Eight primary contrasts use 99.375-percent bounds; secondary 95-percent bounds are exploratory.
analysis.missing_data: Zero in planned denominator; separately report incomplete/unattempted and unknown costs. No imputation of model responses.
analysis.stopping_rule: Fixed assigned sample and safety/cost stops; no effect-based stopping.
robustness_checks: Exploratory bootstrap compared to conservative decision bounds
software_and_versions: Docker image inspection and source SHA retained
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Smoke, incomplete runs, assumption failures, small samples and intervals overlapping the practical region cannot establish benefit.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Complete study and lower bound above 0.05

hypothesis_effects: H-001 strengthened for this contrast; H-002 weakened

risks.mechanism: Hand-selected easy task may favour either system or produce a ceiling.
risks.prevention: Freeze task, prompts, snapshots and outcomes before paid calls.
risks.detection: Report all model/profile cells and controls.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: No population inference; future tasks require a new protocol.

researcher_degrees_of_freedom: Version all amendments; no prompt tuning within an invocation
falsification_checks: MCP host result must agree with raw reference
Unsupported assertions without measurements cannot pass
reporting_controls: Complete manifest and ledger including failed/unattempted trials
residual_limitations: Explanation prose is not independently assessed

ethics_and_safety.rationale: No human participants or private datasets; paid API access and runner resources require bounded use.
mitigations: Token passed at container runtime only
No secret in collector/MCP subprocess environments
Loopback target and at most ten clients
Cost admission allowance and output/call caps
stopping_rules: Provider errors or unknown usage stop model
post_stop_actions: Retain incomplete run; inspect cause; corrections require a fresh invocation

feasibility.access: Repository OPENAI_API_TOKEN secret supplied by operator; exact snapshot access checked by actual calls.
resources: Custom runner with Docker, outbound package and OpenAI access
Smoke admission allowance USD20 total; study USD200 total; estimates are not billing guarantees
blockers: Docker unavailable in the editing environment; image execution and live paid calls await GitHub runner
feasibility.fallback: Retain actual failure or unattempted records; never substitute mock responses for empirical results.

reproducibility.registration: Versioned protocol committed before workflow trials; no independent registry registration claimed.
reproducibility.data_plan: Upload per-trial raw measurements, source, prompts, traces, model response metadata, ledger and summaries; no credentials.
reproducibility.code_plan: All implementation and tests committed in this PR.
reproducibility.provenance_plan: Retain source SHA, dependency versions, Docker image inspection, workflow ID and attempt, provider response IDs and usage.
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: Increment protocol version for planned changes; keep previous invocation artefacts and label reruns.
reproducibility.replication_plan: Run a fresh output directory and workflow invocation without overwriting earlier results; replication shares this task scope.
